name: Liath Sidhe (Monstrous Race)
body:
Core Traits
Type Liath sidhe are fey.
Size: Diminutive As Diminutive creatures, liath sidhe gain a +4 size bonus to their Dexterity, AC and attack rolls, a +12 size bonus on Stealth checks, and a –4 penalty to Strength, maneuver checks, and Cmd.
Senses Low-light vision
Base Speed: Fast 40 ft. Liath sidhe are surprisingly fast for their size.
Ability Score Modifiers: Specialized +2 Str, +2 Con, -2 Wis. Liath sidhe are known to be reckless (with some exceptions), but their physical prowess and hearty temper are legendary.
Languages: Standard Liath sidhe begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Liath sidhe with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Halfling, Terran, and Treant.
Additional Traits
Fearless: Liath sidhe gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear effects.
Illusion Resistance: Liath sidhe gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusion spells or effects.
Stubborn: Liath sidhe gain a +2 racial bonus on Will saving throws to resist spells and spell-like abilities of the enchantment (charm) and enchantment (compulsion) subschools. In addition, if a liath sidhe fails such a save, it receives another save 1 round later to prematurely end the effect (assuming the spell or spell-like ability has a duration greater than 1 round). This second save is made at the same DC as the first. If the liath sidhe has a similar ability from another source (such as a rogue’s slippery mind class feature), it can only use one of these abilities per round, but can try the other on the second round if the first reroll ability fails.
Skill Bonus (Survival): Liath sidhe gain a +2 racial bonus on Survival checks.
Stalker: Perception and Stealth are always class skills for liath sidhe.
Threatening: Liath sidhe gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate check and don’t suffer penalties when trying to intimidate creatures larger than them.
Hatred: Liath sidhe gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against other fey.
Swarming: Liath sidhe are used to living and fighting communally with other members of their race. Up to two liath sidhe can share the same square at the same time. If two liath sidhe that are occupying the same square attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe as if they were in two opposite squares.
Frenzy: Once per day, whenever a liath sidhe takes damage, it flies into a frenzy for 1 minute, gaining a +2 racial bonus to Constitution and Strength, but a –2 penalty to AC.
Portal Sense: Liath sidhe can sense the presence of dimensional portals, gates, or rifts in a 30-ft. radius.
Bold Thief: The carrying capacity of a liath sidhe is calculated as if its Strength bonus were 4 higher.
Bond to This Life: Though they are no more considered as being native of the Faerie World, liath sidhe don’t believe in an afterlife and so can’t be resurrected when they die.
Liath Sidhe Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist: Add 10 minutes to the duration of the alchemist’s mutagens.
Barbarian: Add +1/3 to the bonus from one of the following rage powers: boasting taunt, liquid courage, roaring drunk, staggering drunk.
Bard: Add +1/6 to the number of weird words that the bard can speak.
Bloodrager: Increase the bloodrager’s total number of bloodrage rounds per day by 1.
Brawler: Add +½ to the brawler’s Cmb when attempting a dirty trick or steal maneuver.
Druid: Add ¼ of an additional herbal concoction per day.
Fighter: Add +½ to the fighter’s Cmb when attempting a dirty trick or steal maneuver.
Hunter: Add 1 skill rank to the hunter’s bird, coyote/jackal, dire rat, or giant cockroach animal companion.
Ranger: Add 1/5 to the ranger’s favored enemy bonus against fey. The ranger must have favored enemy (fey) to select this option.
Rogue: Add a +½ bonus to Stealth and Sleight of Hand checks to steal or hide objects.
Shaman: Add one spell from the druid spell list that isn’t on the shaman spell list to the list of spells the shaman knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Skald: Choose one raging song; treat the skald as +1/4 level higher when determining the effects of that raging song.
Slayer: Gain a +½ bonus on Intimidate checks and Survival checks to forage.
Swashbuckler: Increase the number of times per day the swashbuckler can use charmed life by ¼.
Witch: The witch gains 1/6 of a new witch hex.
Wizard: Add one spell from the wizard spell list to the wizard’s spellbook. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the wizard can cast.
